overview_description.description:
Indee Labs is developing hardware for gene delivery. Our hardware is uniquely positioned for the efficient development and scalable manufacture of gene-modified cell therapies such as chimeric antigen receptor T cells.

The technology is being developed with the help of the Australian National Fabrication Facility. We are alumni of NSW Health, IndieBio, Y Combinator and MBC Biolabs (née QB3@953). We are opening up an office in Sydney and have lab space at Bonneville Labs in Berkeley.

product.name: Hydropore™
product.description: A non-viral intracellular delivery platform for gene editing and cell modification, designed for research and cell therapy applications.

product.name: µVS Delivery System™
product.description: A microfluidic mechanoporation platform for non-viral intracellular delivery of gene-editing materials into immune cells.

product.name: Direct DNA Knock-in Kit (in development)
product.description: A kit designed to enable direct insertion of large DNA transgenes into cells using Hydropore™ for gene editing applications.
